entities.summary: Rachel Banham is an American professional basketball player for the Chicago Sky of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and the Lunar Owls of Unrivaled. Banham played guard for the Minnesota Golden Gophers women's basketball team, where she set a number of team records. Banham was drafted by the Connecticut Sun with the 4th pick of the 2016 WNBA draft. Banham was traded to the Minnesota Lynx in 2020, and later re-signed with the Sun in 2024.
